summary: Alpha.1 evidence is mechanically sound, but qualification cannot pass until two merged dependency worktrees are cleaned and two metric statements are corrected.
findings: P1: the wave gate requires clean worktree cleanup, while 4VB97J and 9XC1H0 remained registered at the reviewed SHA.
P2: the structural baseline has ten observed scalar cells, not ten measured cost metrics; seventeen metric kinds exist and six are observed.
P2: the nineteen ratchet violations belong to RF-21, RF-06b/RF-09/RF-25, and RF-05a/RF-05b, not RF-24/RF-27.
evidence_refs: git worktree list --porcelain and task-scoped cleanup proof
hidden_assumptions: Merged and hosted-closed task state was treated as sufficient even though the program gate also requires local cleanup.
residual_risks: Publication remains correctly optional; the rework does not require an alpha.1 package.
